episodes.title: The Agricultural Revolution
episodes.description: Explore the shift from hunting and gathering to farming and its lasting effects on civilization.

episodes.title: Indus Valley Civilization
episodes.description: Investigate the people, places, development, and significance of the ancient Indus Valley civilization.

episodes.title: Mesopotamia
episodes.description: Explore Fertile Crescent societies, early kingdoms, labor systems, and the beginnings of written law.

episodes.title: Ancient Egypt
episodes.description: Trace Egypt's kingdoms through the Nile, pyramids, pharaohs, and burial practices.

episodes.title: The Persians & Greeks
episodes.description: Compare ancient Greek society with Persia and question familiar stories about their historical importance.

episodes.title: Buddha and Ashoka
episodes.description: Explore post-Indus Indian history through Hinduism, Buddhism, and the rule of Ashoka.

episodes.title: 2,000 Years of Chinese History! The Mandate of Heaven and Confucius
episodes.description: Examine Chinese rulers and the Confucian scholars whose writings shaped accounts of their reigns.

episodes.title: Alexander the Great
episodes.description: Explore Alexander's conquests, successor empires, and the historical idea of greatness.

episodes.title: The Silk Road and Ancient Trade
episodes.description: Follow ancient trade routes carrying merchandise, ideas, and disease between China and the West.

episodes.title: The Roman Empire. Or Republic. Or…Which Was It?
episodes.description: Investigate the Republic's transformation into imperial Rome and Julius Caesar's role in that change.

episodes.title: Christianity from Judaism to Constantine
episodes.description: Trace Christianity's Jewish origins and its development within the Roman world.

episodes.title: Fall of The Roman Empire…in the 15th Century
episodes.description: Follow Rome's eastern continuation in Constantinople long after the western empire's collapse.

episodes.title: Islam, the Quran, and the Five Pillars
episodes.description: Explore Islam's origins, the Quran, foundational practices, and the early Muslim community.

episodes.title: The Dark Ages…How Dark Were They, Really?
episodes.description: Compare medieval Europe's difficulties with cultural and intellectual activity elsewhere.

episodes.title: The Crusades – Pilgrimage or Holy War?
episodes.description: Reconsider the motivations, outcomes, and destruction associated with the first four major Crusades.

episodes.title: Mansa Musa and Islam in Africa
episodes.description: Explore trade, Islamic connections, architecture, and powerful states in sub-Saharan Africa.

episodes.title: Wait For It…The Mongols!
episodes.description: Investigate how Mongol pastoral communities built an extraordinarily powerful and extensive empire.

episodes.title: Int’l Commerce, Snorkeling Camels, and The Indian Ocean Trade
episodes.description: Explore Indian Ocean commerce through maritime technology, monsoons, and exchanges of valuable goods.

episodes.title: Venice and the Ottoman Empire
episodes.description: Examine how Venetian shipping expertise and Ottoman power supported mutually beneficial trade.

episodes.title: Russia, the Kievan Rus, and the Mongols
episodes.description: Trace changes from medieval Rus principalities toward Russia, including the influence of Mongol rule.

episodes.title: Columbus, de Gama, and Zheng He! 15th Century Mariners
episodes.description: Compare Columbus, Vasco da Gama, and Zheng He within fifteenth-century maritime exploration.

episodes.title: The Renaissance – Was it a Thing?
episodes.description: Ask whether changes in European learning constituted a sudden Renaissance or a longer cultural evolution.

episodes.title: The Columbian Exchange
episodes.description: Explore the sweeping consequences of contact between the Americas and the wider world.

episodes.title: The Atlantic Slave Trade
episodes.description: Trace slavery's changing forms and the development of racialized enslavement across the Atlantic.

episodes.title: The Spanish Empire, Silver, & Runaway Inflation
episodes.description: Examine Spain's American conquests, silver wealth, inflation, and eventual imperial decline.

episodes.title: The Seven Years War
episodes.description: Explore a conflict fought across five continents and the complications of defining its duration.

episodes.title: The Amazing Life and Strange Death of Captain Cook
episodes.description: Follow James Cook's Pacific explorations, territorial claims, and death in Hawaii.

episodes.title: Tea, Taxes, and The American Revolution
episodes.description: Distinguish the American Revolution from its war while examining colonial grievances and political ideas.

episodes.title: The French Revolution
episodes.description: Compare French and American revolutionary experiences, including terror and renewed authoritarian rule.

episodes.title: Haitian Revolutions
episodes.description: Explore revolutionary ideas of freedom within a Caribbean plantation society dependent on enslaved labor.

episodes.title: Latin American Revolutions
episodes.description: Trace nineteenth-century challenges to Spanish and Portuguese control across Latin America.

episodes.title: Coal, Steam, and The Industrial Revolution
episodes.description: Investigate why industrialization transformed everyday lives so dramatically and where its development began.

episodes.title: Capitalism and Socialism
episodes.description: Connect industrial capitalism, emerging socialist ideas, global companies, and consumer culture.

episodes.title: Samurai, Daimyo, Matthew Perry, and Nationalism
episodes.description: Explore nationalism's role in reshaping empires, states, education, military service, and political belonging.

episodes.title: Imperialism
episodes.description: Examine nineteenth-century European expansion and the creation of colonial spheres in Asia and Africa.

episodes.title: Archdukes, Cynicism, and World War I
episodes.description: Connect an archduke's assassination with a war of unprecedented international participation and scale.

episodes.title: Communists, Nationalists, and China’s Revolutions
episodes.description: Trace the collapse of dynastic rule and China's disruptive twentieth-century revolutionary struggles.

episodes.title: World War II
episodes.description: Explore the origins, meaning, and historical significance of the Second World War.

episodes.title: USA vs USSR Fight! The Cold War
episodes.description: Examine the rivalry between the United States and Soviet Union after the Second World War.

episodes.title: Decolonization and Nationalism Triumphant
episodes.description: Explore the breakup of European colonial empires and the rise of independent nations.

episodes.title: Globalization, Part 1 – The Upside
episodes.description: Follow a T-shirt's international production journey to understand global economic connections.

episodes.title: Globalization, Part 2 – Good or Bad?
episodes.description: Weigh globalization's gains in wealth against inequality, environmental damage, and other social consequences.
